title: Music theory for the guitar you already play
why: Understand the songs I already play on guitar, so they stop feeling like memorised shapes.
successLooksLike: Explain why the chords of a song belong to the same key
Work out the chords of a key from its major scale
constraints: Learns on guitar only; no piano at home

priorKnowledge.title: Plays open chords from chord charts
priorKnowledge.body: Said in the Interview they can strum G, C, D, Em and Am from chord charts, and cannot read staff notation.
